# SimpleSilicon

SimpleSilicon is a free, independent VLSI and semiconductor engineering learning project — no paywalls, no premium tiers, no login required.

## Main Sections
- Academy (/academy): self-paced learning tracks with embedded university video lectures.
- Video Course Library (/learn/video-courses): curated NPTEL university courses and YouTube playlists.
- Resources (/resources): semiconductor engineering role profiles and EDA toolchains.

## Target Audience
VLSI design, verification, physical design, DFT, and EDA engineers; students preparing for semiconductor careers.
